name: FerroBRIDGEXpnToStringValue
title: FerroBRIDGE supplement: XPN to string through $value
description: Overrides ConceptMap/datatype-xpn-to-string of hl7.fhir.uv.v2mappings 1.0.0. The guide writes XPN.1 to the target $this, which its mapping guidelines (§[n] Notation) do not define, with the narrative assignment "/concatenate according to XPN.11/", which no machine evaluates, so the interpreter refuses the row and the string is lost (PID-6, the mother's maiden name, leaves Patient.extension with no value). This supplement writes XPN.1, the family name, into the string itself through $value, which names the element the data type is used at; it assembles no further name parts, since XPN.11 is narrative. Recorded as an upstream defect on FerroBRIDGE #1728.
